summary: A turntable scratch instrument: the SELECT encoder is the jog wheel and the keys drop the needle on a virtual record of SAM speech words or an endlessly generated "WORLD" record.
features: 17 scratch techniques plus COMBO, played by holding keys
100 generated WORLD records built from nine sound materials
Four knob effects: filter, echo, crush and beat-locked stutter
Freeze, crossfader cut, backspin, brake and an auto-scratch mode
Follows MIDI clock; built-in practice drum beat
Version 4.0 removed the sequencer and rap modes of 3.x
